articles.headline: Democrats Score Major Gains in US Midterm Elections
articles.brief: Democrats made significant gains in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, flipping key gubernatorial and Senate seats to deliver a striking rebuke to Donald Trump's party amid widespread voter dissatisfaction.

articles.headline: Amy Acton Defeats Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio
articles.brief: Dr. Amy Acton secured a historic victory in the Ohio gubernatorial race, defeating Trump-backed Vivek Ramaswamy and capturing the office for Democrats for the first time in two decades.

articles.headline: Super Micro Forecasts Strong AI Server Demand Growth
articles.brief: Super Micro has forecasted quarterly revenue above Wall Street estimates, driven by a sustained and robust surge in global demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure servers.

articles.headline: Canva Announces Major Layoffs After Hardest Year
articles.brief: Design platform Canva has announced a massive workforce reduction, cutting 1,271 employees or 22% of its total staff, as the company navigates growth slowdowns and restructures into agile teams.

articles.headline: Ambani's Jio Explores Tech Talks with Comcast
articles.brief: Reliance Industries' Jio is reportedly exploring strategic tech-for-equity discussions with major American telecommunications providers Comcast and Charter, according to industry sources.

articles.headline: India's 2026 Gold Demand Projected to Fall
articles.brief: India's gold demand is expected to drop to a six-year low due to continuous steep price increases, significantly altering retail consumer purchasing patterns across the subcontinent.

articles.headline: Binance Hackers Used Fake Job Interviews in Breach
articles.brief: Investigators revealed that hackers behind a massive $6.3 billion cyberattack on Binance utilized sophisticated social engineering tactics involving fake job interviews to gain entry.

articles.headline: OpenAI Employees Warned Over Security Lapses
articles.brief: Internal sources indicate that OpenAI staff raised concerns about operational security vulnerabilities for years, warning that controls were lax enough for outsiders to access proprietary models.

articles.headline: Spain Transport Minister Resigns After Crash
articles.brief: Spain's transport minister announced his immediate resignation following the latest fatal railway crash in the country, accepting political responsibility for the catastrophic incident.

articles.headline: Trump Says No Immediate Plans to Strike Iran
articles.brief: U.S. President Donald Trump clarified that Washington has no immediate plans for military strikes against Iran, though the military remains fully prepared to act if negotiations stall.

articles.headline: India Faces Prolonged Food Inflation Pressures
articles.brief: From grains to poultry and milk, consumers across India are grappling with persistent food inflation driven by structural supply bottlenecks and erratic weather patterns.

articles.headline: Delhi Reeling Under Severe Air Pollution Levels
articles.brief: Multiple parts of New Delhi plunged into the 'severe' air quality category, with the 24-hour average Air Quality Index hovering at alarming highs according to the CPCB.
